mapper.select: SELECT m.movie_id, m.title, COALESCE( STRING_AGG(DISTINCT g.genre_name, ', ' ORDER BY g.genre_name), '미분류' ) AS genres FROM movies m LEFT JOIN movie_genres mg ON m.movie_id = mg.movie_id LEFT JOIN genres g ON mg.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM screenings s WHERE s.movie_id = m.movie_id AND (s.screening_date + s.start_time) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.title ORDER BY m.movie_id ASC
SELECT movie_id, title, running_time FROM movies ORDER BY movie_id ASC
SELECT movie_id, title, running_time FROM movies WHERE movie_id = #{movieId}

SELECT m.movie_id AS "movieId", m.title, m.director, m.running_time AS "runningTime", m.release_date AS "releaseDate", m.age_limit AS "ageLimit", m.content, ( SELECT STRING_AGG( DISTINCT g.genre_name, ', ' ORDER BY g.genre_name ) FROM movie_genres mg JOIN genres g ON mg.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE mg.movie_id = m.movie_id ) AS genres FROM movies m WHERE m.movie_id = #{movieId}
SELECT s.movie_id AS movieId, COUNT(se.seat_id) AS seatCount FROM screenings s JOIN seats se ON se.room_id = s.room_id AND se.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY s.movie_id

SELECT s.movie_id AS movieId, COUNT(bs.booked_seat_id) AS seatCount FROM booked_seats bs JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id = bs.booking_id AND b.booking_status = 'DONE' JOIN screenings s ON s.screening_id = bs.screening_id GROUP BY s.movie_id
